neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that a dead body was found burning on a conical storage of cow dung cakes known as 'Bitora'. A post-mortem was conducted, revealing the body to be that of a female. DNA testing matched the remains with the DNA profile of the victim's father and mother, confirming the identity of the deceased. The FIR was lodged after the body was discovered. Witnesses stated that the deceased and the accused were familiar with each other and had gone to a village together. PW-4 and PW-5 claimed to have seen the accused with the deceased and her two minor children on January 3, 2004, and that the accused was seen on a Scooty with a gunny bag on it. The prosecution argued that the accused was the suspect, but the court found the evidence insufficient to establish guilt. The accused was acquitted due to the lack of conclusive evidence linking her to the crime.
